name: Lateling
endCardLine: Free plan on the Shopify App Store
spokenEnd: Lateling. Free plan on the Shopify App Store.
audience: Shopify merchants who get "where is my order?" emails
oneLiner: A Shopify app, with an optional Gmail add-on for Chrome, for answering "where is my order?" emails.
facts: Needs attention list: recent orders that have not shipped after a limit the merchant sets, or that the carrier reports as delayed. Oldest first. Each one has a "Possibly late" flag.
Find an order: search by email, name or order number. Guest checkouts are included. The customer card shows how many orders the customer has placed and how much they have spent.

Order detail: items, payment status, fulfillment status, shipping address, delivery status (in transit, out for delivery, delayed, delivered), estimated delivery, tracking links, and a "Copy summary" button.

Reply templates: 17 variables, including customer name, order number, total, items, address, tracking number, delivery status, estimated delivery and sign-off. A variable that cannot be filled stays visible so the merchant notices before sending.
Gmail add-on: a side panel next to each customer email. It inserts a template into the reply. Nothing is sent automatically. It is connected with a one-time code.

Read-only: two permissions, read_orders and read_customers. It cannot refund, cancel or change anything. Order data goes from Shopify to the merchant's browser and is not stored on Lateling's servers.
Looks at orders from the last 60 days only.
Pricing: Free plan with 3 templates, 30 Gmail lookups a month, 1 store. Pro is $9 a month after a 7-day trial, with unlimited templates and lookups and up to 3 stores. Billed through Shopify.
dont: Do not say it sends emails, replies for the merchant, contacts carriers, predicts delays or issues refunds.
Do not say it works with any platform other than Shopify, or any mail client other than Gmail in Chrome.
angles: answering where is my order emails faster
orders that shipped late without anyone noticing
guest checkout customers with no account
an app that cannot change anything in your store
